10月2日更新：Many readers want to see the full vehicle compatibility list for the Twelve South AirFly Drive. Our friendly site 9to5Toys just published one. Check it out!

Twelve South is a company that offers a range of high-end Apple accessories, and has recently significantly expanded its AirFly product line. Today, the company unveiled the AirFly Drive, an adapter that converts wired CarPlay to wireless CarPlay, available for pre-order starting today at a price of US$39.99. Here's how it works.

According to Twelve South, the AirFly Drive is compatible with most vehicles that come with wired CarPlay as standard, covering more than 75 brands and models from 2014 to the present. The AirFly Drive itself uses a USB-A connector, but Twelve South includes a USB-C adapter in the package. It features a compact aluminium design, suitable for leaving plugged in the car long-term.

Twelve South's AirFly Drive requires no apps or accounts. Users simply plug it into the car's USB port and pair their phone once to complete setup. After that, the AirFly Drive will automatically reconnect to the phone, providing a wireless CarPlay experience. It also supports pairing two phones simultaneously, and lets you switch between the two with a single button.

Twelve South lists some of the specs and features:

  • Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto on the car's built-in display.
  • Plug and play, no apps, accounts, or charging required.
  • Fast automatic reconnection every time you start your car.
  • Switch between two paired phones with the press of a button.
  • Compact aluminium housing designed to stay plugged into the car.
  • Supports both USB-A and USB-C, with a USB-A to USB-C adapter included.
  • Works with the car's original display, buttons, and steering wheel controls.
  • Ongoing compatibility updates.

Wireless CarPlay is far smoother than wired CarPlay, especially for short city drives. It's a major upgrade to the CarPlay experience.

The AirFly Drive is available to order starting today from the Twelve South website, priced at US$39.99, in black and white. It also supports Android Auto.
